about: Caption keys for the five places the world screens beside its component details, which tokens/master.json texture.places names without keys. Each entry gives the world's place name, the key a page captions it by, the caption's name and its job (the world's note, except the progress edge, which names its 24 px). Package-owned: tokens/details.json is the world's dump and never takes it. test/captions.test.ts holds this list to the world's places, in the world's order.

places.job: One band per page head, inside crop marks.
